obligations.title: Withdraw external transfer must be safely handled
obligations.why: withdraw performs an external value transfer. Attack harness must model receiver behavior, including payable receive() and reverting receive().

attack_goal.success_condition: unexpected revert, locked funds, or profit after callback behavior
harness_requirements: generate one attacker with payable receive()
generate one attacker with reverting receive()
generate one attacker that attempts reentry if state update order permits

obligations.repair_hint: Preserve checks-effects-interactions; consider pull-payment or explicit failed-call behavior.
